caption: As it opens (Color Belt's event roster): four cards in a row — two by two on phones. Every count card is a button; Payments recorded is a total and can't be tapped (no button, no hover).

A card tapped: it gets the blue edge, the list shows only those rows, and one gray line says so — “Showing not paid only · Show all”. Tapping the card again or Show all shows everyone. Screen readers hear the card as pressed.

Camps' own four (v1.014) in the same look: Campers · Coming (that day) · To collect · Payments recorded. A card can carry one small line under its number (“$1,355”), as Star's Candidates card says “Worcester” and Payments recorded says what it includes today.

Black Belt's four plan cards (v1.013, BB15): the same look and tap behaviour — every card filters, there is no money total. A section can add one gray line under the row (Black Belt's duplicates note). Keyboard focus shows the usual blue ring (here on Late).

Hide private details on (v0.506): only the first card stays — no money and no paid counts — as Color Belt and Star do today. A section whose cards are all about money shows no row at all (Black Belt hides it today).

Black Belt on phones — a change to v0.219. Today phones show no cards, only two pills, “Late 2” and “Not paid 1” (top). With the shared row they get the same 2×2 cards as every other roster (bottom): v1.013 says “the same look and tap behaviour”, and a pill mode would be a second look to keep. Drawn at phone sizes only. If you OK this, the row records that it changes v0.219.
